# ezbudget — AI Working Notes

- **What this is**: Reference for AI agents contributing code here; keep it concise and codebase-specific. Update this doc when behaviors or workflows change.
- **Run basics**: Standard Flutter app (Dart >=3.2). Use `flutter pub get` then `flutter run` (mobile or `-d chrome`). Lints from `flutter_lints`. Tests are minimal; add targeted widget/unit tests when changing UI logic.
- **State management**: Riverpod 3 `NotifierProvider` holds budgets list and exposes aggregates. Providers live in [lib/providers/budget_provider.dart](lib/providers/budget_provider.dart). Always mutate budgets through the notifier methods (`addBudget`, `deleteBudget`, `updateBudget`) so SharedPreferences stays in sync.
- **Persistence**: Budgets are serialized to JSON strings and stored under the `budgets` key in SharedPreferences inside the notifier. On cold start, defaults seed three budgets. There is a legacy file-based helper in [lib/services/budget_storage.dart](lib/services/budget_storage.dart) that is currently unused—don't write new code against it unless you intend to migrate persistence.
- **Data model**: `Budget` holds `label`, `total`, `remaining`, `deductions`, `icon`, and reset metadata; serialization lives in [lib/models/budget.dart](lib/models/budget.dart). Deductions are plain records with `description/amount/date` in [lib/models/deduction.dart](lib/models/deduction.dart). Keep doubles for currency values; conversions rely on JSON round-tripping via `toJson/fromJson`.
- **Auto-reset timers**: Each budget has a `resetInterval` (weekly/monthly) and `resetDate`. On app load, the provider checks all budgets and resets any that have passed their date (`resetBudget()` clears deductions and restores `remaining` to `total`, then `setResetDate()` advances the date). Weekly resets happen on Mondays; monthly on the 1st. Budget tiles display days remaining via `getTimeRemaining()` in shorthand (e.g., "15d").
- **UI entry**: App bootstraps with `ProviderScope` in [lib/main.dart](lib/main.dart) and uses a dark Material 3 theme seeded by blue-grey with Ubuntu fonts from [pubspec.yaml](pubspec.yaml).
- **Main view**: [lib/views/main_view.dart](lib/views/main_view.dart) lists budgets via `BudgetTile`s and shows totals from providers. Layout is orientation-aware: portrait shows a top total header; landscape uses a two-column summary/list. The final list item is always an "Add Budget" card that opens the create dialog.
- **Creating budgets**: Dialog implementation in [lib/widgets/create_budget_dialog.dart](lib/widgets/create_budget_dialog.dart). Validates name/amount (numeric check via `isNumeric` in [lib/utils/helpers.dart](lib/utils/helpers.dart)), lets users pick an icon from a fixed map and choose a reset interval (weekly/monthly), then creates a `Budget` and calls `addBudget` on the notifier. If you add new fields to `Budget`, update dialog construction and serialization.
- **Budget tiles**: UI + interactions in [lib/widgets/budget_tile.dart](lib/widgets/budget_tile.dart). Tapping navigates to SpendView; long-press opens a modal to reset (mutates model + updates provider) or delete (delegates to notifier). Circular progress uses `getPercentageRemaining`; keep it between 0–1 or adjust the indicator logic if you change the model. Days remaining chip displays in shorthand format.
- **Spending flow**: [lib/views/spend_view.dart](lib/views/spend_view.dart) shows budget summary and a form to add deductions. It sorts deductions newest-first each build, mutates the in-memory `Budget` via `spendMoney`, then calls `updateBudget` to persist. If you change deduction structure, adjust sorting/formatting and provider update.
- **Validation & formatting**: Numeric inputs are string-validated via `isNumeric`; currency display uses `NumberFormat.simpleCurrency` from `intl` throughout views/tiles. Keep formatting consistent when adding UI.
- **Icons**: Icon names are stored as strings on `Budget` and mapped to Material icons in both tile and dialog files. When adding icons, update the constant maps in [lib/widgets/budget_tile.dart](lib/widgets/budget_tile.dart) and [lib/widgets/create_budget_dialog.dart](lib/widgets/create_budget_dialog.dart) together.
- **Orientation & layout**: Main and spend views both adjust layout for wider screens. When adding new widgets, test both portrait and landscape to maintain spacing/padding constants defined in their files.
- **Persistence pitfalls**: `BudgetNotifier` writes the entire budgets list on each mutation; avoid holding large objects or non-serializable fields in `Budget`. If you introduce async loads, keep the provider state as `AsyncValue` and use `.when` handling like MainView does.
- **Fonts/assets**: Custom Ubuntu font set declared in [pubspec.yaml](pubspec.yaml) under `fonts`; keep names in sync with `myTheme` in [lib/main.dart](lib/main.dart) if adding typography changes.
- **Adding features safely**: Prefer extending the Riverpod notifier rather than mutating model instances directly in widgets without persistence. Ensure new fields are covered in `toJson/fromJson`, dialog creation, and tile/spend displays.

Please suggest edits if anything here is unclear or missing for your workflow.
